pages.text: TFC modular is a compatibility addon for Truly Modular and Arsenal, allowing TFC's materials and tool types to be used to create modular items. Any item with the $(thing)Modular Item$() tooltip can be converted into a modular tool and any item with the tooltip $(thing)Modular Material$() can be used in any module that allows that material. Of course we can't get very far without the star of the show, the $(thing)Modular Workbench$().

The $(thing)Modular Workbench$() is the heart of the mod. It allows you to create, tweak and repair your modular items. To craft it, you will need a $(thing)hammer$(), a $(thing)chisel$() and a $(thing)saw$(). These items are CONSUMED on use, so make sure you're not giving it your only tools.
pages.title: Modular Workbench

pages.text: Any tier can be used, even modular items if you somehow got those before the workbench. Modular items show up invisible in recipes.
